svg.title: White Diagonal Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-last-paintings-05-2017/lightbox/works/white-diagonal-curve-2015-42888; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
